_comment_threshold: Opportunity threshold = Latino VAP share of enacted District 6 (the most Latino-concentrated district in the enacted OR plan). District 6 has 17.4% Latino VAP — the highest in the state. Oregon has no majority-Latino district, so this is the realistic demographic ceiling the enacted map achieves for Latino electoral opportunity. The chain requires every proposed plan to preserve at least 1 district at or above this share where the Latino party-of-choice (D) wins. This is the correct single-election simplification of the Becker et al. group-control-factor approach: with one binary election outcome, the GC factor min(2k,1) reduces to a hard VAP floor anchored to the enacted benchmark.
